text: 金十数据9月18日讯，今日早盘，恒生科技指数开涨后震荡走高，盘中一度涨超2%。截至中午收盘，恒生指数收涨0.67%，恒生科技指数收涨1.74%。芯片股大涨，天数智芯(09903.HK)涨超13%，壁仞科技(06082.HK)涨超9%，华虹宏力(01347.HK)涨超6%；光通信板块走强，曦智科技-P(01879.HK)涨超17%；人工智能股回升，MINIMAX-W(00100.HK)涨超13%，智谱(02513.HK)涨超6%；除此以外，液冷、创新药、电讯设备、中资券商、智能驾驶、商业航天、新消费等板块涨幅居前。煤炭、奶制品、电池、建材水泥、港口运输等板
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 18 - In today's morning session, the Hang Seng Tech Index opened higher and then fluctuated upward, rising more than 2% at one point. As of the midday close, the Hang Seng Index rose 0.67%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.74%. Chip stocks surged, with Iluvatar CoreX (09903.HK) up more than 13%, Biren Technology (06082.HK) up more than 9%, and Hua Hong Semiconductor (01347.HK) up more than 6%; the optical communications sector strengthened, with Lightelligence-P (01879.HK) up more than 17%; AI stocks rebounded, with MINIMAX-W (00100.HK) up more than 13%, and Zhipu (02513.HK) up more than 6%; in addition, liquid cooling, innovative drugs, telecommunications equipment, Chinese brokerage, intelligent driving, commercial aerospace, new consumption and other sectors were among the top gainers.
